messages:
Maria: quick heads-up — ran into an intermittent stale-read right after a write to a prefix. read returned pre-write values for ~5-20ms. is this the eviction/residency propagation race we talked about earlier?
Ken: yeah sounds like it. our eviction path marks and background compaction + async residency updates can leave a short window where other nodes still route to an old slab view.
Alex: saw this in stress tests for ephemeral tenants. two practical mitigations: (A) short-lived write-held pin to keep residency around for N ms, (B) read-repair check that consults a recent write-log before returning. both have tradeoffs.
Maria: thinking we add an opt-in flag on the write path: "touch_on_write" (ttl_ms). on write we bump prefix pin/refcount and schedule a delayed decrement. default off. cheap outside hammer cases.
Deploy-bot: FYI feature-flag path exists: /flags/runtime/prefix_touch_on_write (can be toggled per-tenant).
Tara: reasonable, but cost question — if lots of tiny writes happen, won't pinned bytes spike and pressure evictions harder?
Alex: yes, that's the main cost. keep ttl small (25–200ms) and enforce caps: pinned_bytes_per_node and pinned_prefix_count_limits. also add a sampling metric for pinned_payload_bytes.
Ken: rollout plan idea: start as Dedicated-only opt-in, canary on a few latency-sensitive teams, add alerting on pinned_bytes > threshold. add counters: evict_after_write, read_repair_hits.
Maria: impl sketch: reuse current prefix refcount store. on write do: increment_ref(prefix), write_to_store(), schedule_timer(ttl_ms, decrement_ref). add jitter to decrements to avoid synchronized churn. unit tests: simulate write->read within 0–100ms windows and assert visibility.
Alex: also add a fallback: if a read hits and sees no residency, it can consult a tiny recent-write cache (in-process LRU) for immediate consistency in extreme low-latency settings. prefer pin unless memory tax is unacceptable.
Jordan: product question — what should hosted defaults be? opt-in only?
Ken: recommend opt-in for hosted; Dedicated customers can opt-in at tenant config. we can expose a simple toggle in Console with a recommended ttl.
Maria: action items: I'll open an RFC with API sketch, metrics list, tests, and canary steps. owners: Alex (impl) + Ken (telemetry + rollout). will link RFC here when created. :thumbsup:
